name: 311 Service Requests
description:
311 Service Requests received by the City of Chicago. This dataset includes requests created after the launch of the new 311 system on 12/18/2018 and some records from the previous system, indicated in the LEGACY_RECORD column.

For purposes of all columns indicating geographic areas or locations, please note that requests of the type 311 INFORMATION ONLY CALL often are entered with the address of the City's 311 Center.

top.item: Tree Trim Request (NO LONGER BEING ACCEPTED)
Sign Repair Request - All Other Signs

columns.name: SR_SHORT_CODE
columns.description: An internal code corresponding to the Service Request Type. This code allows for searching and filtering more easily than using the full SR_TYPE value.

columns.name: CREATED_DEPARTMENT
columns.description: The department, if any, that created the service request.

top.item: BACP - Business Affairs and Consumer Protection
DFSS - Department of Family & Support Services

columns.name: OWNER_DEPARTMENT
columns.description: The department with initial responsibility for the service request.

top.item: BACP - Business Affairs and Consumer Protection

columns.name: ORIGIN
columns.description: How the request was opened. Some values, such as Generated In House and Mass Entry result from the City's own operations.

columns.name: DUPLICATE
columns.description: Is this request a duplicate of another request?

columns.name: LEGACY_RECORD
columns.description: Did this request originate in the previous 311 system?

columns.name: LEGACY_SR_NUMBER
columns.description: If this request originated in the previous 311 system, the original Service Request Number.

columns.name: PARENT_SR_NUMBER
columns.description: Parent Service Request of the record if applicable. If the current Service Request record has been identified as a duplicate request, the record will be created as a child of the original request.

columns.name: CREATED_HOUR
columns.description: The hour of the day component of CREATED_DATE.

columns.name: CREATED_DAY_OF_WEEK
columns.description: The day of the week component of CREATED_DATE. Sunday=1

columns.name: X_COORDINATE
columns.description: The x coordinate of the location in State Plane Illinois East NAD 1983 projection.

columns.name: Y_COORDINATE
columns.description: The y coordinate of the location in State Plane Illinois East NAD 1983 projection.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: The location in a format that allows for creation of maps and other geographic operations on this data portal.

columns.name: Boundaries - Wards (2023-)
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Boundaries - Wards (2023-)' (du4m-ji7t) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

Metadata.Frequency: Data are updated multiple times per day
